idle.notes: Relaxed ready stance, breathing; feet planted.

stance_earth.notes: Wide low horse stance; slow heavy breathing, feet planted.

stance_fire.notes: Forward pressure stance with light bounce.

stance_air.notes: Light on the balls of the feet, open palms.

walk.notes: Natural forward walk, relaxed opposite arm swing. In-place loop for ground speed 1.4 m/s: stride 1.26 m per cycle (two steps of 0.63 m); stance footprints move backwards at exactly 1.4 m/s, so feet do not skate when the root moves at that speed (scale playback by actual_speed / 1.4). Hips are lowered automatically wherever a planted leg would overstretch.

run.notes: Forward run, forefoot-ish contacts, 90-degree arm drive, 12 deg lean. In-place loop for ground speed 5.5 m/s: stride 3.30 m per cycle (two steps of 1.65 m); stance footprints move backwards at exactly 5.5 m/s, so feet do not skate when the root moves at that speed (scale playback by actual_speed / 5.5). Hips are lowered automatically wherever a planted leg would overstretch.

strafe_l.notes: Combat strafe to the character's left, guard up, facing forward. In-place loop for ground speed 1.1 m/s: stride 0.99 m per cycle (two steps of 0.50 m); stance footprints move backwards at exactly 1.1 m/s, so feet do not skate when the root moves at that speed (scale playback by actual_speed / 1.1). Hips are lowered automatically wherever a planted leg would overstretch.

strafe_r.notes: Combat strafe to the character's right, guard up, facing forward. In-place loop for ground speed 1.1 m/s: stride 0.99 m per cycle (two steps of 0.50 m); stance footprints move backwards at exactly 1.1 m/s, so feet do not skate when the root moves at that speed (scale playback by actual_speed / 1.1). Hips are lowered automatically wherever a planted leg would overstretch.

walk_back.notes: Backpedal with guard up, toe-first contacts. In-place loop for ground speed 1.0 m/s: stride 0.90 m per cycle (two steps of 0.45 m); stance footprints move backwards at exactly 1.0 m/s, so feet do not skate when the root moves at that speed (scale playback by actual_speed / 1.0). Hips are lowered automatically wherever a planted leg would overstretch.

evade_l.notes: Quick low sidestep/hop to the character's left; feet leave the ground ~0.2-0.3 s, land on the stance spots. contact = apex of the dodge.

evade_r.notes: Quick low sidestep/hop to the character's right. contact = apex of the dodge.

evade_back.notes: Backward hop with lean away, low silhouette. contact = apex of the dodge.

evade_fwd.notes: Forward dive-step, head low. contact = apex of the dodge.

jump.notes: Crouch, explosive extension, feet leave ground at contact (0.17 s). Ends in rising pose; blend to fall/glide.

fall.notes: Airborne descent: arms up/out for balance, legs staggered and trailing. Loops.

land.notes: Touchdown at contact (0.07 s), knees absorb, rise to ready. Feet planted from contact on.

glide.notes: Arms spread, body pitched ~35 deg forward, legs trailing; gentle wing flutter. Loops.

air_dash.notes: Burst: tuck then streamline forward (superman). Hold last pose or blend to glide/fall.

guard.notes: Held block: forearms up in front of face/chest, knees bent; slight tension breathing.

deflect.notes: Sharp cross-body parry with hip turn; contact = hand meets the strike.

earth_wall.notes: Stomp (contact 0.17 s) then both palms rise to push up the wall. Starts/ends in earth stance.

hit_front.notes: Hit from the front: chest and head snap back, arms jerk up; feet planted. contact = impact frame.

hit_back.notes: Hit from behind: arches back, head thrown up, arms swing back; feet planted.

hit_heavy.notes: Big balance loss: thrown back, front foot leaves ground, arms fling wide, stumbles forward and recovers.

knockdown.notes: Struck, tumbles backward, slams the ground (~0.55 s) and settles lying on the back; ends on LYING pose. contact = first impact. Body extends ~0.9 m behind and ~0.7 m ahead of root.

getup.notes: Lying on back -> heels pulled in -> sit-up -> squat -> stand into the idle ready pose. Feet planted on the idle spots from 0.17 s. contact = null.

stagger.notes: Off-balance wobble in place: arms out, knees give, foot re-plants. Light reaction.

earth_lift.notes: Stomp (0.1 s), hands drive up pulling a stone: contact = stone pops (0.2 s). Starts/ends in earth stance.

earth_throw.notes: Driving straight punch/push with the right hand; hips drive forward, feet planted. contact = fist lands (0.17 s).

earth_heavy.notes: Scoop low, heave overhead, drive forward-down; contact at the end of the heave (0.47 s). Starts/ends in earth stance.

earth_hold.notes: Both hands cupped around an invisible mass at chest height (mass centre ~ (0, 0.30 fwd, 1.2 m)); strained tremble. Loops.

water_draw.notes: Flowing S-curve pull from low-and-back to high-and-forward; contact = water released at the top (0.37 s).

water_hold.notes: Both hands circling a sphere of water in front of the chest (opposite phase), weight swaying; planted feet. Loops.

water_whip.notes: Wide horizontal arm arc (right arm) with torso whip; contact = arm sweeps through the front (0.23 s).

water_freeze.notes: Reach out with open hands then clench both fists with a shoulder-tensed squeeze; contact = clench (0.27 s).

water_shield.notes: Arms rounded in front like a ring/shield, hands slowly orbiting; low planted stance. Loops.

fire_jab.notes: Quick lead-hand jab, hips and shoulder snap forward; contact = fist extension (0.1 s).

fire_charge.notes: Both fists chambered at the hips, torso coiled forward, tense vibration. Loops.

fire_release.notes: Double palm strike from the chambered pose; contact = palms land (0.1 s). Ends in fire stance.

heat_draw.notes: Rooted stance; open palms slowly pull toward the chest (extracting heat) then push out. Loops.

magma_hold.notes: Cupped hands around a glowing mass (centre ~ (0, 0.26 fwd, 1.0 m)), hunched, intense fast tremble. Loops.

pour.notes: Raise, then push the mass down and sweep it forward along the ground; contact = mass hits the floor (0.27 s). Feet stay planted in the wide stance; starts/ends in the magma_hold stance.

lightning_charge.notes: Both arms trace a vertical ring (r=0.25 m) in front of the chest with extended fingers; hands half a turn apart. Loops.

lightning_release.notes: Right-hand two-finger thrust; contact = fingertips land (0.07 s). Ends in a ready pose.

air_push.notes: Two-hand open palm push with a small pivot of the hips; stays on the balls of the feet; contact = palms release (0.13 s).

air_gust.notes: Wind-up, airborne 360-degree pirouette on the balls of the feet, lands with a two-palm thrust; contact = landing + thrust (0.37 s). Hips/foot yaw end at -360 (== rest orientation).
